title: T1011.001 — Exfiltration Over Other Network Medium - Exfiltration Over Bluetooth
subtitle: The animation shows a compromised office laptop.
aria: T1011.001 - Exfiltration Over Other Network Medium - Exfiltration Over Bluetooth

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Foothold
steps.caption: The attacker controls the victim laptop through a phished session and plans a quiet exit, because the C2 channel is watched. Local rights are enough to run the built-in Bluetooth tools. EDR records the office document spawning a script, but no network transfer has happened yet
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.caption: The attacker packs finance files into one 1.8 GB archive in a temp folder. Staging keeps the transfer short and tidy. file telemetry shows a large after-hours archive write, which is the first half of the story

steps.title: Push over OBEX
steps.caption: The archive leaves in staggered pieces over OBEX, the Bluetooth file-push profile, using the built-in fsquirt tool on Windows. Nothing crosses the corporate firewall or proxy. fsquirt runs under the script lineage while egress logs stay silent
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.
